chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Miskān, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the best of what the sunnah (prophetic tradition) has established regarding salat (prayer). He said: “Completing the fifty.”

key_terms.أَفْضَلِ: the most excellent or most virtuous
key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the established prophetic tradition and normative practice
key_terms.الْخَمْسِينَ: the fifty prayers, referring to the complete number of daily obligatory and supererogatory prayers

ai.seo_question: What is the best sunnah (prophetic tradition) practice regarding salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the most excellent practice established in the sunnah (prophetic tradition) concerning salat (prayer) is to complete the fifty prayers, meaning the full set of obligatory and recommended daily prayers. It highlights the merit of maintaining the complete daily cycle of prescribed devotional prayer.
